4.0.0.rawDesc:
The deep, blue ocean of Roully Bab Binb or Really Big Pond in the kender
tongue was named by the kender of Arkane to the north.  Seemingly having the
'happy-go-lucky' persona itself, the waters are generally pleasant with good
trade-winds and good weather.  The waves dance about, and appear happy to
carry your ship.
